prompt:
One continuous 8-second portrait shot of Tavi revealing an expansive Bali holiday world in an exquisite handmade paper theatre. Begin exactly at the excited closed-case first frame and finish at the delighted completed-world last frame. Preserve the same original coral vintage suitcase identity, textured paper craft, navy trim, brass corners, cream tag, folded-paper arms and wheels.

Performance priority: Tavi is eager, enthusiastic, curious and proudly delighted. His normal-sized eyes stay FULLY OPEN and alert with visible cream whites and navy pupils throughout, apart from very quick ordinary blinks. No sustained half-lidded expression, sleepy lids, bored face or smug deadpan. Animate his raised brows, eye direction and smile through distinct reactions; do not freeze one expression.

0–0.6 seconds: he looks warmly at the traveller with bright open eyes and a small excited preparatory tilt, ready to show something wonderful.
0.6–2 seconds: he opens the rear-hinged lid backwards. His face remains clearly visible on the front panel. As it opens, his brows rise and his smile briefly becomes a delighted little O of anticipation.
2–5.8 seconds: an ENTIRE lavish Bali paper world unfolds out of the case into the upper two thirds and sides of the portrait, reaching the supplied final landscape. Emerald terraces fan out, tall palms spring open, temples unfold, paper sea waves curl into place, sun and mountain rise, foreground flowers unfold. Stage these as successive physical pop-up-book movements with visible paper edges and warm shadows. Tavi's eyes follow a rising palm and sun for a brief beat; he gives a joyful small body lift while both wheels remain grounded, then proudly presents the world with his free arm.
5.8–7 seconds: Tavi turns his bright eyes back towards the traveller, gives one delighted little nod, and opens both arms in a warm 'look what we made' presentation. A small leaf drifts past his arm as the stage settles.
7–8 seconds: hold the rich completed landscape and excited happy final-frame pose, with a subtle natural blink and a gently changing smile. Keep his eyes attentive and the face lively.

Fixed eye-level camera, no cuts, no zoom, no shake. Preserve the warm sophisticated travel-poster palette and tactile dimensional paper material. The landscape must grow from inside the suitcase and expand around him, not simply replace the background or sit on a tiny tray. Keep loose folded paper out of his face. No text, logos, UI, voice, confetti, extra limbs, changing face shape, floating wheels, photoreal people, plastic gloss or frantic cartoon bouncing. Silent.
